pr_body:
This change adds the ENRICH `match_field`s to the field_caps call performed while resolving the index pattern. This addresses scenarios where the match_fields are not explicitly called for in the query and when the index pattern resolution will not use all fields (`*`). A query of the type `from test | enrich countries | keep country_name` doesn't use `ENRICH ... ON ...` (so the field name is not explicitly mentioned) and also asks for a specific field name (thus not using `*` during index pattern resolution).

Fixes https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/101328
pr_title: ESQL: adds Enrich implicit match_fields to field_caps call
pr_comment: Hi @astefan, I've created a changelog YAML for you.

review_comment: Nothing to do with the fix in this PR, but I believe these field names are more clear like this. `-ignoreCsvTests` were suggesting imo that the whole file is ignored in all test suites. In fact, those fields are ignored in CSV unit tests only.
